story.hook: The miniature city needs one giant paw
story.caption_explanation_en: An expedition leader shields a fragile orbital city as frozen balloons point toward an unseen evacuation route.

source_concepts.concept_en: a silent orbital station with drifting sunlight and safe VFX debris
the hero's giant paw shields a detailed miniature city
a daring explorer guiding a discovery team

story.overview_ko: 버려진 궤도 정거장에서 고양이 탐험대장이 미니어처 도시를 보호하며 풍선의 피난 신호를 읽는다.
story.continuity_ko: 동일한 주인공과 탐험용 가죽 조끼, 따뜻한 햇빛과 차가운 우주 잔해의 대비를 유지한다.

creative_fingerprint.twist_ko: 태풍 전날 풍선들이 모두 안전한 방향을 가리킴
camera_setups: 45mm centered eye-level orbiting dolly, miniature city beneath raised paws and debris halo arranged as radial graphic

images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 blockbuster frame inside an abandoned orbital station with drifting sunlight and safe VFX debris. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. As a daring treasure-hunt expedition leader in an original canvas utility vest, the cat shows offended open-mouth protest and is standing tall with forepaws elevated, securely supported by a hidden studio platform. One giant white paw shields a detailed miniature city during a harmless staged defense moment. A book-shaped prop opens beside the city, revealing a bookmark cat whose fur changes color and historical era between pages. Frozen debris forms a circular halo, while a cluster of storm-eve balloons all point toward an evacuation route. Camera distance four meters, centered eye-level viewpoint, 45mm lens, medium depth of field with cat and miniature city crisp, warm sun shafts against cool station shadows, realistic fur, glass, paper, balloon tension, floating debris, and contact shadows. Safe miniature compositing, no danger or crushing. Correct feline anatomy, no duplicate cats, no extra limbs, no human features, no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, or readable title.
